Infleqtion has entered into a memorandum of understanding (MOU) with Riverlane to collaboratively explore real‑time quantum error correction techniques. The partnership aims to evaluate advanced quantum protocols that could improve the reliability of quantum computing operations, potentially enhancing high‑performance computing workflows. The agreement reflects both companies’ focus on leveraging research breakthroughs to accelerate practical quantum applications.
